run_protoc_compile: run protoc to compile proto files into Python pb2 and pb2_grpc modules
create_directory_tree: create a nested directory tree from a sequence of path component lists idempotently
massage_proto_content: substitute package namespaces and import paths in raw proto file content bytes
packagify_directory: add empty __init__.py files to every subdirectory under a given directory
test_protoc_plugin_split: test gRPC protoc plugin behavior with split proto files across multiple compilation styles
